mapper.select: SELECT ph.product_holding_id, ph.account_id, ph.product_id, fp.product_name, fp.product_type, ph.quantity, ph.avg_nav, ph.purchase_amount, ph.update_at FROM product_holding ph JOIN financial_product fp ON ph.product_id = fp.product_id WHERE ph.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY ph.update_at DESC

SELECT fp.product_id, fp.product_name, fp.product_type, SUM(ph.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(ph.avg_nav * ph.quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(ph.quantity), 0) AS avg_nav, fp.nav AS current_nav, CAST(SUM(ph.avg_nav * ph.quantity) AS SIGNED) AS purchase_amount, CAST(SUM(fp.nav * ph.quantity) AS SIGNED) AS current_value, CAST(SUM((fp.nav - ph.avg_nav) * ph.quantity) AS SIGNED) AS profit_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(ph.avg_nav * ph.quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM((fp.nav - ph.avg_nav) * ph.quantity) * 100.0 / SUM(ph.avg_nav * ph.quantity) END AS return_rate FROM account_link al JOIN product_holding ph ON ph.account_id = al.account_id JOIN financial_product fp ON fp.product_id = ph.product_id WHERE al.member_id = #{memberId} AND ph.quantity > 0 GROUP BY fp.product_id, fp.product_name, fp.product_type, fp.nav ORDER BY current_value DESC, fp.product_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_holding(account_id, product_id, quantity, avg_nav, purchase_amount, update_at) VALUES(#{accountId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{avgNav}, #{purchaseAmount}, #{updateAt})
